question: Find the mean proportional between 16 and 81.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The mean proportional between two numbers a and b is given directly by √(a × b).

Here, a = 16 and b = 81.

Mean proportional = √(16 × 81)

⇒ 4 × 9 = 36

**∴ The correct answer is 36.**
